response.sql: WITH combinations AS (SELECT s.transref, t.tradekind, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON s.transref = tr.transreg JOIN trader AS t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_optvolrt) AS value FROM combinations), deviations AS (SELECT c.tradekind, c.avg_optvolrt, c.avg_optvolrt - b.value AS deviation FROM combinations AS c CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE b.value IS NOT NULL), type_averages AS (SELECT d.*, AVG(d.deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY d.tradekind) AS type_avg_deviation FROM deviations AS d) SELECT tradekind, AVG(avg_optvolrt) AS avg_option_volume_ratio, AVG(deviation) AS avg_deviation, AVG(deviation - type_avg_deviation) AS avg_excess FROM type_averages WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL AND deviation > type_avg_deviation GROUP BY tradekind
